verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a cloud platform, since on-premises or self-managed deployment of the core services is conceivable, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only shows AWS as hosted cloud services (EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS). The only open-source items are client-side tooling (the CDK framework and the MCP servers), not the core platform, so there is no evidence that it can be self-hosted.
